## Download

Click **oilApp.exe** under *Assets* below.

## First-time setup (Windows)

1. Make a folder called **Oil App** on your Desktop and move **oilApp.exe** into it.
2. Double-click **oilApp.exe**. If Windows says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. A black window opens, then the app opens in your browser. Keep the black window open while you use the app, and close it to quit.

Your wallet and trades are saved in **oil_data.sqlite**, which appears next to oilApp.exe the first time it runs. Keep the two files together.

**Updating from an older version:** close the app and replace the old oilApp.exe with this one. Leave oil_data.sqlite where it is and your progress carries over.

Having trouble? See the [instructions and troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/README.md#troubleshooting).
